subtitle: Help renovate the community hall — keep film nights, bingo, and senior socials alive.
brief:
Build a one-page fundraiser site for "Save the Community Centre" — a charming fundraiser to renovate a dated community hall used for film nights, bingo, and senior socials.

The page features a short looping hero video (warm, nostalgic, documentary feel — elderly folks gathered around a film projector in the hall) and a prominent "Donate Now" button linking to https://example.com/donate.
visual_bible: Shot on 16mm film. Warm documentary grade with gentle grain. Honey-toned wood-panelled community hall, soft overhead lighting, elderly people in cardigans gathered warmly around a vintage film projector or a folding table covered in 35mm film strips. Muted earth tones. Shallow depth of field. Played completely straight — nostalgic, warm, hopeful, NOT comedic. 16:9.
shots: Hero shot: elderly folks gathered warmly around a vintage film projector, soft overhead lighting catching dust motes, hands resting on the projector handle. Slight motion implied — gentle camera push, ambient warmth.
palette_hint: warm honey/cream with deep burgundy accents
